description: Maps repository directory names to project slugs for the engineering journal pipeline.
rules: Every worklog entry MUST have the correct project slug in its frontmatter.
When a repo maps to a project that is not yet published on the website, still use its correct project slug — do not merge it into another project's logs.
If a day's work spans multiple repos, create separate project sections in the journal entry, each with its own correct project slug.
When adding a new project to the website, register it in this mapping file first.
